title: Visual teaching and animation review
scope: Review every lesson from its complete script, each scene and its meaningful animation states. Record the exact images and movies inspected. Encoded review follows source revisions. A production pass establishes technical reliability; editorial judgment establishes teaching value.

dimensions.criteria: Displayed numbers, geometry, units, input identities and decisions come from the same model state. Worked steps establish every quantity needed for the result. Narration agrees with the visible state.

A concrete opening establishes why the question matters. The lesson develops the mechanism from first principles, connects steps and gives the learner a useful prediction or comparison before its payoff. Examples support a general explanation.

The viewer can identify the current object, operation and result. Math is typeset, labels remain readable and stable, containers fit, connections have clear endpoints, and attention follows the intended explanation.

Motion exposes the mechanism: quantities accumulate, distributions change, geometry transforms, or identifiable objects move through an operation. Changes receive visible cues. Stable information stays quiet. Important transitions contain inspectable intermediate states and hold their result.

The voice explains the reasoning and draws attention to the current change. It leaves room to inspect, avoids repeated numerical lists, uses natural examples, and supplies useful pauses. Timing is checked against the measured narration. Audible expression requires a separate listening review.

The exact final MP4 passes geometry, occlusion, text, motion, decode and playback checks. Captions preserve paragraph or sentence boundaries. Review records bind the current movie, source and viewed image hashes.

conditions: Every scene has a concrete teaching purpose and a reviewed sequence of states or an explained intentional hold.
Every actionable prior finding is resolved or remains explicitly open with a reason.
Changing numbers are connected to their visual consequence and receive a focused change cue where the update would otherwise be easy to miss.
The source revision has an encoded review before it can be accepted as a delivered video.
An unchanged lesson includes a specific explanation of the visual mechanism that meets the standard.

scoring: Award demonstrated points and explain deductions. A target never justifies increasing a score. Technical or synchronization defects block acceptance regardless of total. Record sampled review honestly and keep it separate from full-stream automated analysis. The rubric sets an editorial target; it does not certify superiority to another creator.
